shape-quoted-newline-dialect.summary: A small comma CSV with a quoted line break is refused with E_DIALECT, and the suggested next command pins a tab delimiter.

rvl-non-numeric-stock-profile.summary: With a profile from profile draft init and freeze, rvl --non-numeric reports numeric changes as categorical and hides the real status transition.

shape-lock-verification-null.summary: After a successful --lock check shape reports input_verification null, so the sealed report carries no lock provenance.

shape-non-csv-dialect.summary: For XLSX and Parquet input shape reports a CSV dialect.

profile-inspect-numeric-extremes.summary: profile inspect prints exact numeric cell values (min and max) in default mode.

veil-allows-explicit-on-protected.summary: Released veil allows spine tools with --explicit on protected files. bd-en1 is fixed on veil main but not in a release.

twinning-port-zero-no-readiness.summary: With --port 0 --serve twinning prints nothing until shutdown, so a client must ask the operating system for the port.

twinning-embedded-verify-raw-values.summary: The default report from twinning's embedded verify carries raw row keys and cell values; standalone verify redacts them.
